model: BlueNet BN PRO intelligent PDU (Modbus TCP)
applies_to: Bachmann BlueNet BN PRO rack PDUs with Modbus TCP, protocol v1.00 REV00 register list.
summary: BlueNet BN PRO is a family of intelligent rack PDUs with metering at inlet, phase and outlet level, residual-current monitoring and optional sensors. Modbus TCP exposes everything as read-only holding registers (FC 03) with fixed decimal resolutions. This map covers inlet, phase and outlet measurements, energy counters, MCB and RCM status, residual currents, GPIO and external temperature/humidity sensors.

addressing.note: Each row prints a 1-based register number plus the 0-based wire address in hex and decimal. The 'documented' column here is the register number; the address is the printed decimal address (register - 1). Register 18 (inlet current) is requested as address 17 (0x0011).

source.title: BlueNet BN PRO Modbus TCP v1.00 Protocol - ModBus Register (Read Holding Register 0x03)
source.pages: pp. 2-33 (inlet p. 2, phases pp. 3-4, MCB pp. 5-6, RCM pp. 6-7, outlets pp. 7-25, GPIO and external sensors pp. 26-33)

notes: Energy counters are split into a register named 'High Byte' followed by one named 'Low Byte'. Each pair is listed as one 32-bit value at the 'High' register, high word first (ABCD), as the names indicate.

The list gives a resolution for each value but no data type. Status and power-factor-suffix codes include negative numbers, so they are INT16; temperatures are listed as INT16, other measurements as UINT16. Check signedness on site if a value can go negative.
Single and main PDUs answer to unit ID 1. Linked PDUs in a cluster answer to the unit ID of their position in the cluster.
Power factor is unsigned (resolution 0.001); the separate 'Power Factor Suffix' register says whether the load is inductive (1, LA) or capacitive (-1, LE).
MCB current registers are left out: the list prints no resolution or unit for them.
Several hex addresses in the list do not match the decimal column (e.g. phase 2 suffix: register 182 printed as 0x00B1 but decimal 181); the decimal column, which always equals register - 1, is used.
The list is read-only (FC 03 only); there are no switching or reset registers.
Outlet blocks are listed for outlets 1-36.
Humidity rows print only '%' as resolution; they are listed with scale 1.

integration.summary: Connect to the PDU's IP address with Modbus TCP, unit ID 1 for a single or main PDU, and read holding registers with FC 03. Inlet values start at address 16; scale each register by its resolution.
integration.enable: The register list does not say how Modbus TCP is enabled on the PDU or which TCP port it uses; check the BlueNet PDU documentation.
quirks: Register numbers are 1-based; send the decimal address (register - 1).
Values are integers with fixed resolutions (0.01 A, 0.1 V, 1 W, 0.1 kWh, 0.1 °C).
Linked PDUs use unit IDs by cluster position.
setup: Use unit ID 1 for single and main PDUs.
gotchas: Status registers return negative codes (e.g. -2 connection lost) for offline outlets or sensors.
Read each energy pair (high + low register) in one request to avoid a torn value.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
